def: A layer with many parallel expert MLPs in which a router sends each token to only a few of them.
One of the parallel MLPs in a mixture-of-experts layer; it is a part of one network trained together, not a topic specialist.
The small linear layer that scores every expert for a token and selects the top k.
The softmax weight, over the chosen experts, with which each selected expert's output is added to the layer's output.
Every weight in a mixture-of-experts model, counting all experts; this sets the memory needed.
The weights a single token actually uses: the shared parts plus its k chosen experts per layer; this sets the FLOPs per token.
A failure in which a few experts receive nearly all tokens and the rest are rarely trained or used.
A small extra loss, proportional to the sum of each expert's token share times its mean router probability, that pushes routing towards even use.
The multiple of the even token share that each expert is given room for; tokens beyond it are dropped.
Placing different experts on different GPUs, so tokens are exchanged between GPUs by two all-to-all steps per layer.
An expert that every token uses, holding common knowledge so the routed experts can specialise.
